payload.unit_title: R21 Drawing Hall Controller & Sheet Evaluation Backend (M2.6)
payload.objective: Report findings of read-only analysis M2.6-ANALYZE-001 and role dashboards architecture; request authorization to begin M2.6 Slice 1 implementation.
payload.explicit_request: Completed read-only analysis for M2.6 and role dashboards architecture. Zero repository changes made. All 55 tests pass. Requesting PLAN_APPROVED decision authorizing M2.6 Slice 1 (backend controller, models, migration, and dedicated feature test).

task_report.summary: Completed read-only architectural analysis of M2.6 (R21 Drawing Hall Controller & Sheet Evaluation Backend) and comprehensive role dashboards migration architecture. Formulated legacy-to-target parity map, statutory SBTE Kerala Regulation 11.2.3 requirements, implementation slice decomposition, and an anti-duplication role dashboard strategy utilizing CampusLynk master shells (<x-layouts.faculty-shell>, <x-layouts.dashboard-layout>) and <x-ui.*> components.

tests.output: Tests: 55 passed (416 assertions) in 2.95s. Zero regressions.

payload.reason: M2.6-ANALYZE-001 is approved and M2.6 Slice 1 is authorized. The analysis establishes a concrete statutory parity map for R21 Drawing under Clause 11.2.3, including formative sheet evaluation, summative series-test evaluation, attendance/performance marks, CIA consolidation, pass eligibility, course-file initialization, and lesson-plan generation. The proposed backend scope appropriately reuses the existing CampusLynk architecture while introducing only the Drawing-specific persistence and controller layer required by the legacy parity gap. The role_dashboards addition is also architecturally accepted as a dedicated future feature, split into M9.1–M9.4 around shared shells and role families rather than duplicated monolithic dashboards. It should be formally registered in the control plane at the next appropriate checkpoint, but it must not interrupt the deterministic M2.x R21 dependency sequence. M2.6 therefore proceeds first, followed by the analyzed M2.7 frontend/print work, while role_dashboards remains explicitly tracked for later execution. Slice 1 must remain strictly backend-focused; its later frontend counterpart must use <x-layouts.workspace-layout>, <x-layouts.report-layout>, existing <x-ui.*> components, and sub-500-line Blade decomposition. The reported 55-test baseline is clean, the analysis made no repository changes, and User.php remains protected.
